opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search with sort/filter
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights from {origin} to {destination} for {trip type} on {depart date}/{return date}, then open Sort & Filter and apply a sort or fare option (e.g., Price low to high, Points).
steps: Type the origin in 'From' and pick the suggestion
Type the destination in 'To' and pick the suggestion
Choose Roundtrip or One-way
Open the Depart date picker and pick the depart date
Pick the return date if the trip is roundtrip
Click 'Search flights' and 'Continue to flight results'
Open 'Sort & Filter', choose the sort option (e.g., Price low to high) or fare type (Points), then Apply

instances.values: New York -> Miami, roundtrip 27th-31st, filter Points / Price by Core
New York -> Toronto, one-way on the 29th, sort Price (low to high), opened details
New York (NYC) -> Aruba (AUA), roundtrip returning Fri May 5 2023, sort Price (low to high)

opportunities.name: Budget careers job search by filters
opportunities.description: On Budget Careers > Openings, filter jobs by {country}, {team} and {time type}, then search and optionally open a posting to apply.
steps: Click 'Careers' and then 'Openings'
Open the 'Country' filter, search, and pick the country
Open the 'Team' filter, search, and pick the team
Open the 'Time Type' filter, search, and pick the time type
Click 'SEARCH BY JOB TITLE OR KEYWORD'
Optionally open a job posting and click 'APPLY NOW'

instances.values: United States of America, Finance, Full time; applied to Accounts Payable Associate
United States of America, Finance, Full time

opportunities.name: United car rental search
opportunities.description: On United's CAR tab, search for rental cars at {pickup location} from {pickup date} to {drop-off date}, with optional times and book-with-miles.
steps: Click the 'CAR' tab
Optionally check 'Book with miles'
Type the pickup location and pick the suggestion
Open the Pickup date picker and pick the pickup date and drop-off date
Optionally set the pickup and drop-off times
Click 'Find cars'

instances.values: Brooklyn - Central (New York), Apr 9-15 2023, default times

opportunities.name: NPS find a park by activity or topic
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, use Find a Park > Search by Activity or Topic, pick a {filter type} and {checkbox values}, and search.
steps: Click 'FIND A PARK'
Click 'Search by Activity or Topic'
Open the 'Activity' or 'Topic' section
Check the desired option(s)
Click 'Search'

opportunities.name: MTA bridge & tunnel toll lookup by vehicle type
opportunities.description: On new.mta.info, go to the Bridges & Tunnels tolls page and view toll rates for {vehicle type}.
steps: Go to Bridges & Tunnels (Menu > Agencies, or Fares & Tolls > Bridges and Tunnels tolls)
Open 'Tolls by vehicle' / 'Toll Rates'
Pick the vehicle type (e.g., Cars, Motorcycles)
View the rates for the crossing

opportunities.name: Product search with max price and add to cart
opportunities.description: Search a retailer for {product keyword}, set the maximum price to {max price}, open a result, and add it to the cart.
steps: Type the product keyword in the site search and submit
Enter the maximum price in the price filter and apply it (GO/Go)
Open a matching product
Click 'Add to Cart'
